make_text_file_shards: create text shards from a file or glob pattern using chunk, round-robin, or sort algorithms
make_chunk_text_shards: split a single text file into N contiguous byte-offset shards for parallel processing
make_roundrobin_text_shards: distribute lines across N shards in round-robin fashion so each shard gets every Nth line
TextShardingConfig_make_shards: configure and create filtered text shards with custom columns, batch size, and separator from CSV or TSV files
TextOutputConfig_write_batch: write a data batch to a compressed TSV or CSV file with custom separator and iteration index
